title: OK, Cool Summer Throw but Too Small
text:
OK, Cool Summer Throw but Too Small. I really love having cooler lightweight throws for the summertime. While we don’t need the warmth it’s still nice to cover up on the couch for a nap.

We have used this throw for a couple months and really like both the weight of it and the soft material. It folds up easily and stores neatly within the included storage bag. When stored it could be used as a small travel pillow.

Laundering could be easier as, while it can be washed, it can’t be dried so it has to be air dried. Luckily since the fabric is so lightweight this doesn’t take too long so that isn’t a huge deal.

It has snaps where the blanket can be worn if desired, we found this pointless and silly.

Without question the biggest drawback to this product is it’s just too small for nearly any adult. While this will work to cover a child, it really is too small to expect to stay covered unless you remain curled up without moving. We’ve decided to use this as a travel blanket as it’s lightweight and portable - the clip on the storage bag easily attaches to our carry on case so it will be there when we need it.

I would recommend this as a potential travel blanket but not as a sofa throw as it’s just not large enough. While we like many aspects of the product, it could be so much better if it were just larger. And I would assume few would miss the snaps if they were left off.
